title: Grouping
body:
Syntax: group invite <player>  |  group accept  |  group  |  group leave  |  group kick <player>  |  group disband

Description: A group shares experience from mob kills -- form one with a party of up to 6 to level up together, rather than every kill only benefiting whoever lands the final blow. Groups are temporary: they aren't saved, and only exist while members are actually online.

&Cgroup invite <player>&x - Invites someone in your current room. Starts a new group if you weren't already leading one.
  &G[Active]&x

&Cgroup accept&x - Joins the group that just invited you.
  &G[Active]&x

&Cgroup&x (no arguments) - Shows your group's roster and everyone's current HP.
  &G[Active]&x

&Cgroup leave&x - Leaves your current group. If you were the leader, leadership passes to another member automatically.
  &G[Active]&x

&Cgroup kick <player>&x / &Cgroup disband&x - Leader-only: removes one member, or dissolves the whole group.
  &G[Active]&x

&D(Shared XP only -- ryo, loot, and mission progress from a kill still go solely to whoever landed the kill, not split with the group. Only every group member who's in the SAME ROOM as the kill, and still alive, gets a share -- an equal split of the kill's full reward, not everyone getting the full amount.)&x

Date: 2026-08-17
